add.intro: The device ID is the tracker's MQTT identity — the same string it publishes under and authenticates with. It is permanent and must be unique; the server rejects duplicates.
add.invalidId: The device ID may contain only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores (up to 64 characters).
add.shareHint: Share with other people now (optional). You always keep full access to devices you register.
